title: Dutch Chicken Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful tagine dish made with tender chicken, crunchy vegetables, and aromatic spices, inspired by Dutch cuisine.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together chicken broth, mustard, and spice blend. Add chicken and mix well.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to pot. Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add bell peppers and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Return chicken to pot and pour in chicken broth mixture. Stir to combine.
Cover pot and transfer to preheated oven.
Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and sauce has thickened.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
